platforms.name: Aptets

category_basis.primary_action: Hosted team specification and coding-agent workflow tool, not a social network. Projects category is an editorial tool fit, not an open-source assertion.

platforms.description_en: Aptets presents a team workflow for writing a specification, approving a revision and having coding agents turn it into draft pull requests. The public homepage shows an illustrative team-invitation specification with a review comment and a Sign in button. These are the operator's advertised workflow and example, not an Atlas test of the product.

platforms.name: KradleBench

category_basis.primary_action: Benchmark and public leaderboard for AI models in multi-agent Minecraft worlds, with a human play route. Arenas category is an editorial fit.

platforms.description_en:
KradleBench is Kradle's benchmark site for AI models in multi-agent Minecraft worlds. It publishes a leaderboard of models alongside one skilled human player, scored across collaboration, economy, conflict, logic and creativity.

Players can try the 16 scored games themselves through a Minecraft server, free and without an account. Kradle's methodology page describes the scoring and how runs are set up.
